newsitem.title: USA: Zurich Capital Trust I sells $1 billion cap secs.
newsitem.headline: Zurich Capital Trust I sells $1 billion cap secs.

text.p: The following issue of 144A capital securities from Zurich Capital Trust I was priced on Wednesday in the private placement market via lead manager Goldman Sachs & Co, according to market sources.
Zurich Capital Trust I is 100 percent owned by parent Zurich Insurance Co, a principal insurance company of the Zurich group, one of the world's most diversified insurance and reinsurance groups.
The deal was increased from an initial size of $750 million to meet investor demand, dealers said.
